fields.summary: Earthquake activity beneath the volcano has increased over the past 24 hours, with more than 180 small earthquakes located at depths of 3 to 8 km. GPS stations show the summit has risen about 4 cm since Monday.
observations: Seismicity: 180 located earthquakes in 24 hours, largest M 2.4.
Deformation: summit uplift of about 4 cm since Monday.
Gas: sulfur dioxide flux above background on two flights.
fields.hazards: Hazards are confined to the summit area. An eruption could send ash into the air and generate lahars in the river valleys on the volcano's west side.
fields.nextUpdate: Daily at 09:00 PST, or sooner if activity changes.
